title: Microwave Chocolate Chip Cookie
instructions: Adapted preparation: soften the butter in a mug, stir in the sugar and vanilla, then mix in the yolk. Fold in flour, salt, and chocolate chips. Microwave until the center is just set, then rest briefly before serving.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Adapted preparation: heat the sugar, syrup, and water in a large microwave-safe bowl in short bursts, stirring between bursts. Stir in the peanuts, continue until amber, then mix in baking soda. Spread thinly on a lined tray and cool completely before breaking.

title: Microwave Rice and Vegetables
instructions: Adapted preparation: combine rice and water in a deep covered microwave-safe dish. Cook until tender, stirring once, then fold in the vegetables and heat until hot. Finish with soy sauce and let stand covered for a few minutes.

title: Microwave Baked Potato
instructions: Adapted preparation: pierce the potato several times, rub it with oil, and season it. Microwave until a knife slides through the center, turning once. Rest before splitting and serving.

title: Easy Spaghetti with Tomato
instructions: Adapted preparation: boil the spaghetti until tender and reserve a little cooking water. Warm garlic in olive oil, add the tomatoes, and simmer briefly. Toss with the pasta, loosening with cooking water as needed, and season.

title: Microwave Tuna Pasta
instructions: Adapted preparation: cook the pasta in a deep microwave-safe bowl with water, pausing to stir until tender. Drain carefully, then fold in tuna and mayonnaise. Top with cheese and heat until melted.
